qs.q: A premature infant develops intraventricular haemorrhage from germinal matrix bleeding. What type of hydrocephalus does this pathology typically produce?
qs.e: Intraventricular or subarachnoid blood impairs CSF reabsorption outside the ventricular system at the subarachnoid cisterns or arachnoid granulations, resulting in communicating hydrocephalus. Obstructive hydrocephalus requires a block inside the ventricular system.
qs.s: Hydrocephalus: Causes, Presentation and CSF Diversion (Shunts): MCQs

qs.q: A newborn infant requires bedside assessment of ventricular size and evaluation for intraventricular haemorrhage through the open anterior fontanelle. Which imaging modality is most suitable and non-invasive for this initial step?
qs.e: Cranial ultrasound performed through the open anterior fontanelle is an accessible, radiation-free bedside method to assess ventricular size and intraventricular haemorrhage in infants. CT or MRI are performed later or if higher anatomical resolution is needed.
qs.s: Hydrocephalus: Causes, Presentation and CSF Diversion (Shunts): MCQs

qs.q: A neonate with communicating hydrocephalus following intraventricular haemorrhage requires a temporising intervention while awaiting definitive management. What is the preferred measure when it works?
qs.e: Serial lumbar punctures are the preferred temporising measure in communicating hydrocephalus after intraventricular haemorrhage in neonates when effective. Ventriculoperitoneal shunting is a permanent surgical intervention rather than a temporising serial procedure.
qs.s: Hydrocephalus: Causes, Presentation and CSF Diversion (Shunts): MCQs

qs.q: An infant requires temporary CSF diversion for intraventricular haemorrhage and ventriculitis, but definitive shunt placement is delayed because the CSF has high protein content. Why is high protein problematic for a shunt?
o: It causes immediate distal bowel perforation
It degrades the silicone tubing material
It would block a shunt valve
qs.e: High protein in the CSF would block a shunt valve, which is why an external ventricular drain is used until the CSF is clear. It does not directly degrade the silicone tubing or cause bowel perforation.
